title: A tiny immediate-mode UI of your own
hints: Detect "pressed this frame" and "released this frame" in `beginFrame` by comparing with the previous frame's button state, and keep the active ID as a member that survives `beginFrame`.
Every widget calls one shared `behave(label, hot)` helper that does hover, activation and clicking. The widgets only differ in what they draw.
requirements: Widgets are laid out top to bottom with the sizes given.
IDs follow lesson 1.05's label rules and the ID stack.
A click is a press and a release over the same widget, across frames.
Only the active ID survives between frames.
stretch: Add `slider(label, float* value, float min, float max)`: while active, the value follows the mouse's x position across the 100-pixel width (lesson 2.01).
